stats.notes: Only the enrollment and the applications and admissions sections are filled in on the Common Data Set PDF (first-year applicants 2,285 men + 2,554 women; admits 2,070 + 2,319). The enrolled count is not shown because the form's enrollee fields disagree with each other; the international and in-state/out-of-state split is blank in the form; there is no test, GPA or admission-factor data. College Navigator (IPEDS fall 2024): 5,037 applicants, 89% admitted, 13% of admits enrolled. Undergraduate enrollment is 3,436 (total undergraduates in the Common Data Set, fall 2025); the student-faculty ratio is 13:1 from College Navigator (the Common Data Set gives 12:1).

cds_test_policy.notes: The Common Data Set's test-policy item is blank; the policy comes from the admissions site.
